It is placed under `organ part` (UBERON:0000064) and `part_of` the `uterus` (UBERON:0000995). The synonym **"fundus uteri"** has also been added with the reference you provided (PMID:39112955).

I also confirmed that the PMIDs originally flagged as potentially incorrect in an earlier comment—**PMID:41204538**, **PMID:40653088**, and **PMID:39112955**—are all valid recent publications, so they have been retained as definition and synonym references.
